claim_ceiling: local vocabulary needed to test the Foundation composition; not Lab or CyberAlchemy-v2 definition admission

definitions.meaning: An identity presented to a host for one bounded evaluation; presentation alone does not establish verified human identity or authority.
An owner-qualified boundary in which identifiers, policies, grants, and effects are interpreted.
A scoped, principal-bound, capability-instance-bound permission claim that must be checked at use time and is not implied by installation.
A closed declaration of the effects an invocation may request; an empty envelope is effect-free.
A host-local binding of one exact Capability Instance version; installation is neither activation nor authority.
A request by one exact principal to prepare or execute one exact Capability Instance under one host claim and effect envelope.
A host-owned immutable account of an attempted execution; Foundation preflight evidence is not an Execution Receipt.
